description_en: Configures the advanced attack mitigation feature, including the feature status and settings
description_zh: 配置高级攻击防护开关和防护策略
name: ConfigLayer4SwitchAndDefense

parameters.help_en:
The port forwarding rule that you want to manage.

Each port forwarding rule contains the following fields:

eip: required. The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance. Data type: string.
protocol: required. The type of the forwarding protocol. Data type: string. Valid values: tcp and udp.
frontend_port: required. The forwarding port. Data type: integer
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的端口转发规则。

每个端口转发规则包含以下字段：

eip：String类型，必选，DDoS高防实例的IP。
protocol：String类型，必选，端口转发协议类型。取值：tcp、udp。
frontend_port：Integer类型，必选，转发端口
parameters.name: listeners

parameters.help_en:
The configurations for the advanced attack mitigation feature. The configurations include the following fields:

switch: required. Specifies whether to enable the advanced attack mitigation feature. Data type: string. Valid values: off and on.
template: required. The mode for the feature. Data type: string. Valid values: hard, default, and weak
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的高级防护开关和策略模板。
switch：String类型，必选，高防防护开关。取值 off、on。
template：String类型，必选，告警防护策略模板。取值：hard、** default、 weak**
